title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Level Review: Standing Rules and Retired Clauses
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — rules of the level review of the plan tier.**

## Clauses in force

- A level review runs only while the plan status is active.
- Plans that are paused or suspended keep their tier until they are active again and reviewed.
- The plan moves up at most the tier's upgrade step count (one tier on every tier) at one review.
- A worker cannot buy, request or be granted a tier outside the review.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are **no longer in force** for any review of the plan tier. Every review of the plan tier is now held under the tier review or the missed-recovery review, each of which states its own scope, when it falls due, where the plan lands and from when the tier applies.

1. *Retired:* The plan tier is reviewed each payday, after that payday's recoveries and any shortfall are booked.
2. *Retired:* The plan moves up when it meets every entry gate of the next tier: the tier's minimum tenure counted in calendar days from the hire date on the plan to the payday, the tier's run of consecutive full recoveries (consecutive paydays, latest first, that had an amount due and no shortfall, stopping at the first payday with a shortfall; paydays with nothing due neither count nor break the run), no open shortfall (zero or less) where the gate requires it, and no write-off with an entry date within the tier's write-off-free period in calendar days before the payday.
3. *Retired:* A payday with a shortfall moves the plan down by the tier's downgrade steps at that review, never below Paystride Access Starter, and a write-off returns it to Paystride Access Starter when the tier carries a write-off reset; a downgrade and an upgrade never happen at the same review, the downgrade prevailing.
4. *Retired:* The new tier applies to transfers booked from the day after the payday, which is recorded as the level effective date.

## Entry gates named in retired clause 2

The gate values remain the tiers' stated figures.

| Tier | Minimum tenure (calendar days) | Consecutive full recoveries | No open shortfall | No write-off within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 0 | 0 | not required | 0 |
| Paystride Access Standard | 30 | 2 | required | 180 |
| Paystride Access Plus | 60 | 4 | required | 180 |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 90 | 6 | required | 180 |
| Paystride Access Premier | 180 | 10 | required | 365 |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 365 | 16 | required | 365 |

The downgrade steps of retired clause 3 are 0 on Paystride Access Starter and 1 on every other tier.

## Points of judgement on the clauses in force

- A plan that is paused on the day a review would run keeps its tier; it is reviewed once it is active again.
- No tier is granted on a worker's request, whatever the worker's history.
